summary: Mangoceuticals, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a June 29, 2026 private placement of 850,000 shares of restricted common stock at $0.32 per share to an accredited investor, raising $272,000. The transaction is a routine capital raising under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D, with piggyback registration rights for one year. No special-situation event occurs; it is not a restructuring, strategic review, or transformative deal. This is an ordinary shelf takedown-equivalent for a small public company. There are no deal terms beyond price and shares; no premium, break fee, or regulatory clock applies. Watch for potential dilution effects on the thinly traded stock.
